paid_plans: Basic $15/mo (10k emails; overages $1.80/1k); Pro $16.50/mo (10k; $1.30/1k); Platform $18/mo (10k; $1.20/1k); custom high-volume available

resolution_notes: pricing: auditor right — paid_plans was wrongly null; official pricing lists Free (100/mo), Basic $15, Pro $16.50, Platform $18 (all paid start at 10k emails) https://postmarkapp.com/pricing. rate_limits: auditor right — no public 10 msg/s email-API cap; docs only define HTTP 429 for excessive use https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview; migration guide states no hard req/s limit https://postmarkapp.com/migration-guides/sendgrid; SMTP recommends 10 concurrent connections/IP (not msg/s) https://postmarkapp.com/support/article/do-we-have-rate-limits-for-smtp; Status API (separate) is 10 req/s https://status.postmarkapp.com/api; batch max 500 https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api
